newsitem.title: USA: Norland Medical settles acquisition suits.
newsitem.headline: Norland Medical settles acquisition suits.

text.p: Norland Medical Systems Inc said Wednesday that is has reached an agreement in principle to settle the class and derivative action seeking to block its proposed acquisition of Norland Corp, the exclusive worldwide supplier to Norland Medical.

Subject to approval by a Delaware court, the plaintiff has withdrawn his application for a preliminary injunction against the acquisition, and the company is preparing supplemental proxy material for a stockholders' meeting to vote on the acquisition.
That meeting, originally scheduled for August 20, will be delayed until the new material is ready, said the company.
Norland Medical Systems markets, sells and services a wide range of bone densitometers used to assess bone mineral content and density.
